item.title: White House press secretary dodges question on Trump getting a sudden MRI scan: 'I’ll check back...'
item.description: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt faced repeated questions regarding President Trump's recent MRI at Walter Reed, offering little explanation beyond it being a "follow-up appointment" and reiterating his "optimal physical health." Trump himself stated his test results were "perfect," though concerns about his health persist due to visible bruising and swelling.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sydney Sweeney breaks silence on American Eagle jeans row: ‘I don’t really let other people…’
item.description: Actress Sydney Sweeney described her viral American Eagle campaign, which sparked accusations of promoting "whiteness" and eugenics, as "surreal." The controversy escalated when President Trump and Vice President Vance defended Sweeney, reframing the debate. Sweeney stated she knows who she is and what she values, unaffected by external definitions.
item.dc:creator: TOI Entertainment Desk

item.title: Top Indian American immigration attorney hails Trump’s H-1B reforms as ‘light over darkness’ for international students
item.description: Recent H-1B visa reforms prioritize international students with advanced U.S. degrees, creating more opportunities for skilled graduates to remain in the country. While this shift aims to retain talent, it also introduces higher filing costs and stricter employer requirements, potentially affecting smaller businesses.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Any Jew who votes for...': Donald Trump attacks Zohran Mamdani ahead of NYC polls
item.description: President Trump attacked Democratic nominee Zohran Mamdani on Truth Social, calling him a "self-professed Jew hater" and deeming any Jewish voter supporting him "stupid." The remarks, made as voting began, intensified controversy surrounding Mamdani's views on Israel and his potential to become the city's first Muslim mayor.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Former NYC mayor Bill de Blasio votes for Mamdani wearing viral ‘Hot Girls for Zohran’ T-shirt — see photo
item.description: Former NYC Mayor Bill de Blasio enthusiastically endorsed mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani, voting in a "Hot Girls for Zohran" T-shirt. Meanwhile, Donald Trump criticized Mamdani, labeling him a "communist" and warning of potential federal funding cuts for New York City.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: Air Arabia expands Ras Al Khaimah operations with new direct route to Kazan, Russia
item.description: Air Arabia has launched its first direct flight between Ras Al Khaimah and Kazan, Russia, marking its third Russian destination after Moscow and Yekaterinburg. The weekly service strengthens UAE–Russia connectivity and supports Ras Al Khaimah’s growth as an aviation and tourism hub. The airline now operates over 190 routes from five international hubs.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Oman to mark National Day with first ever formal two day holiday starting 2025
item.description: Starting in 2025, Oman will officially observe National Day as a two-day holiday on 20 and 21 November, marking the historic 1650 expulsion of Portuguese forces. The celebrations highlight national identity, cultural heritage, and community pride, featuring parades, fireworks, camel races, and traditional events, while giving citizens an extended period to reflect, rejoice, and spend time with family.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: As ex-prince Andrew loses royal titles, what happens to ex-wife Sarah Ferguson?
item.description: Prince Andrew's royal titles and Royal Lodge residence are gone. This affects his ex-wife, Sarah Ferguson. She faces eviction from the Windsor estate home. Ferguson also confronts financial instability and a future without royal protection. This marks a significant shift in royal family management under King Charles. The monarchy prioritizes accountability and austerity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Growing anti-Hindu sentiment’: Indian-origin Congressman slams JD Vance over remarks about wife Usha’s faith
item.description: Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi criticized Vice President JD Vance's remarks about his wife's Hindu background, deeming them detrimental to the rising anti-Hindu sentiment in the US. Vance expressed hope his wife would convert to Christianity, stating her Hindu family was not particularly religious.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: David Beckham becomes Sir David Beckham
item.description: Football legend David Beckham was formally knighted by King Charles III at Windsor Castle, a moment he called the proudest of his professional life. The honour recognizes his significant contributions to sport and extensive charitable work. Beckham's journey, marked by past controversies, now solidifies his legacy as a sporting icon and influential figure in British society.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: 4.6-magnitude Musandam earthquake shakes Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah
item.description: A magnitude 4.6 earthquake struck south of Musandam, Oman, on November 4, 2025, at 4:40 PM local time. The shallow quake, at a depth of 5-10 km, sent light tremors through parts of the UAE, particularly Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah. No damage or casualties were reported in the UAE, with authorities assuring public safety.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dick Cheney: The 'war on terror' architect who loved being called Darth Vader
item.description: Cheney died in November 2025 at the age of 84 from complications of pneumonia and heart disease. His family called him “a noble giant of a man.” His critics might call him the architect of ruin. But everyone agrees: he reshaped the American presidency, bent the arc of global history, and never once looked back. Long before Trump normalised authoritarian instincts in public, Cheney operationalised them in secret without even bothering to tweet about it. Cheney might have found redemption among Never-Trumper liberals, but for those who have to live in the world, Darth Vader has no redemption — only the haunting echo of the Imperial March.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta

item.title: How much money is Asmongold making from Kick? Streamer reveals huge paycheck and compares it to Twitch
item.description: Popular streamer Asmongold revealed shocking earnings on Kick, making $165,178.32 in October 2025 from 30 paid streams, significantly more than his $19,763 on Twitch during a similar period. He attributed the higher pay to Kick's Creator Incentive Program but stated he has no intention of switching exclusively, valuing streaming on both platforms.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is Michelle Scully? Twitch's global communications head leaving after a year and a half
item.description: Twitch's Global Head of Communications, Michelle Scully, is departing after a year and a half. Her tenure saw her strengthen the streaming platform's global messaging and voice amidst rapid industry shifts. Twitch is now seeking a successor to build on this foundation, expanding its reach beyond gaming into broader entertainment and cultural spheres.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Deshae Frost fights back with explosive rant following Asmongold’s photoshopping accusations
item.description: Streamer Deshae Frost has responded to Asmongold's accusations of photoshopping his $300,000 monthly revenue claims. Frost denies the allegations, providing context on subscriber and view surges, and inviting audits to verify his earnings. This exchange highlights the importance of transparency and verifiable evidence in creator revenue disclosures within the streaming community.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Indian-origin MAGA activist stirs row after comparing Zohran Mamdani’s possible NYC win to 9/11; called a ‘sold-out liar’
item.description: Dinesh D'Souza ignited online fury by equating Zohran Mamdani's potential mayoral win to the 9/11 attacks. Critics condemned the Indian-origin commentator's remarks as racist and hypocritical, highlighting the irony of his stance. Mamdani's progressive platform has alarmed conservatives, fueling speculation about MAGA's growing unease.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Tommy Robinson thanks Musk after being cleared of terrorism charges: Why the UK right-winger is crediting the billionaire
item.description: British right-wing figure Tommy Robinson, cleared of terrorism charges, publicly thanked Elon Musk for funding his legal defense. Robinson's arrest and questioning were deemed unjustified by a London court. He credits Musk, who reinstated his X account, for enabling his fight against perceived 'state censorship' and supporting free expression.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Elon Musk claims NYC ballot lists Zohran Mamdani twice, calls it a 'scam' — gets schooled online
item.description: Tech mogul Elon Musk has weighed into New York's mayoral race, endorsing Andrew Cuomo and warning that a vote for Curtis Sliwa would aid Democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani. Musk criticized the ballot system, calling it a "scam.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Nearly a million New Yorkers say they will leave city if Zohran Mamdani wins
item.description: As Zohran Mamdani heads toward a likely mayoral victory in New York City, a recent poll reveals nearly a million New Yorkers may flee under his administration, potentially triggering a historic exodus. This mass departure, largely driven by Mamdani's "tax the rich" rhetoric, could have severe economic consequences, shaking the city’s financial and social stability.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘End filibuster now’: Trump pushes GOP to end nuclear option; warns of ‘brutal’ midterms
item.description: Former President Donald Trump urged Republicans to eliminate the Senate filibuster, arguing it's crucial for passing their policy agenda and securing electoral victories. He warned that retaining the rule would lead to legislative inaction and harm the party in upcoming elections, advocating for its immediate termination to enable the passage of key conservative priorities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
